fields.description:
# PL-9: BA Attribution Mismatch Flagging

_Flags a mismatch between the BA on an incoming Sign Up/SLC and the Player's Assigned BA for Ops review, instead of blocking it._

### AUTOMATION

* Compare the BA on each incoming Sign Up / Study Link Click (SLC) against the Player's Assigned BA (PL-2)

* On mismatch, flag the SLC for Ops review rather than blocking it — Kobi Kunasekaran, 08/18: "we can flag it at the SLC level... if the assigned BA doesn't match the one that came in from that click, we could flag that click for review by Ops."

* Ops can correct and reprocess, or mark as fraud

* Correct the Player's Assigned BA and reprocess the SLC (associates normally to the signup), or mark the SLC as fraud directly — no Signup record gets created from it in that case.

* Starting as a manual Ops review, not automated correction

* Emily Vandenberg, 08/18: "I think the manual review... why don't we start with that?" Kobi noted this can be revisited for automation later if volume grows.

### IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENTS

* Same flag-don't-block pattern as PL-2's referrer mismatch logic

* Assigned BA, Primary Referrer, and Secondary Referrer are all set from the first signup and flagged (not blocked) on a later mismatch — this story is the BA half of that mechanism; see BUILD-174 (PL-2) for the referrer half.

### NOTES

* Provenance: PL-9 (Player Record User Stories doc).
* Depends on the Sign Up and SLC objects existing — no Asana tickets for those yet.

### SOURCE

* [Taryn doc PL-9 — Player Record User Stories](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1OSqt7ilS1feVS7aVxAYSsBZIcTrc1J31_WnQiVucEJg/edit)
* [Aug 18 Weekly Sync — Kobi Kunasekaran, 1:17:39 (SLC-level flag mechanism)](https://fathom.video/calls/787411922?timestamp=4659)
* [Aug 18 Weekly Sync — Emily Vandenberg, 1:18:27 (start with manual review)](https://fathom.video/calls/787411922?timestamp=4707)
* Dependencies: [BUILD-173 — Player: Core Details fields](https://app.asana.com/1/1202721605677544/project/1215732799516730/task/1217684264652851), [BUILD-174 — Player: Attribution fields](https://app.asana.com/1/1202721605677544/project/1215732799516730/task/1217685557162828)
* Owner (proposed): Taryn Reithofer
* Remember to update the requirements documentation as part of this change.
* Created 2026-08-20 from Player record documentation review.
